summary.motive: Put the backside end in an instant give-or-keep conflict using downhill pistol run physics.
summary.whyItWorks: The pistol keeps the back moving forward at the mesh, so any aggressive crash by the read key surrenders the A-gap before the defense can reroute pursuit.
summary.failureMode: The end squeezes and spilles simultaneously while staying square, clogging both branches until help arrives.

beats.title: 1. The Pistol Mesh and Read
beats.text: The pistol alignment puts the back downhill at the snap. The quarterback seats the mesh while staring at one man — the unblocked backside end.

beats.title: 2. The Crash Gives It Away
beats.text: The end shoots inside hunting the quarterback. By attacking the keep he hands the give branch an empty A-gap, and the ball comes out instantly.

beats.title: 3. Downhill Through the A-Gap
beats.text: The back presses downhill behind the scoop-and-climb guard while the quarterback carries the boot fake the other way, freezing the pursuit.

beats.title: 4. Second-Level Finish
beats.text: With the Mike scooped and the safety taking a bad alley angle, the back finishes vertically into the open middle field.

relations.tell: The running back is directly behind the quarterback at six yards and hits the line downhill — gun reads develop a half-yard deeper.
